facts.detail: The collection is published by Building Digital UK and the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology.
The Project Gigabit contract collection was first published on 24 October 2025.
The collection was last updated on 20 July 2026.
Project Gigabit is described as the government programme to bring gigabit-capable broadband to hard-to-reach communities.
BDUK states that it releases monthly updates of premises contracted and built under each Project Gigabit contract.

guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit National Rolling Open Market Review May 2026

facts.detail: The May 2026 National Rolling Open Market Review was published on 1 May and formally closed on 1 June 2026.
The May 2026 National Rolling Open Market Review is marked as concluded.
Suppliers were asked to submit premises-level information about existing and planned gigabit-capable build.
The review covers planned build over the next three years across the UK.
BDUK states that the National Rolling Open Market Review takes place three times a year in January, May and September.

facts.detail: The Ofcom checker accepts a postcode to show mobile coverage by provider and broadband-service availability.
The checker reports availability categories including standard, superfast and ultrafast broadband.
Ofcom provides checker results through interactive maps.
Ofcom publishes fixed-broadband and mobile data APIs for developers.
Ofcom states that users unable to get 10 Mbit/s download may be eligible for the broadband Universal Service Obligation.
